cards.title: The middle of the yield curve is the bit that actually prices your shares — and this week it moved most
cards.why: Fully sourced to the US Treasury's own table, and it explains a move everyone else is attributing to the Trump-Xi summit; the 3/5/7-year +16bp versus +14bp at the 2-year and +11bp at the 30-year is a concrete, teachable fact a family investor has never had explained to them.
